The beers from my self-guided Rauchbier tour in Bamberg, Germany

Hmmmm....not sure how I would feel about a ham-flavoured beer. I was wondering about that dark one.....was that flavour overpowering?

Does anyone have any tricks they use to make homemade jerky? I don't have a dehydrator or fancy slicer so I'm looking for kind of a getting started guide. Thanks!

Jerky is so easy really. But you got to get a dehydrator to make things really easy. You can get a really good one for 50$ on line or go to Bass Pro.

Save time! Go to Walmart and buy meat cut for milanese. It will say it right on the package. Very thin sliced. All you have to do is cut it in strips.

Marinate over nite! Basic recipe: 1cup Braggs amino acid. Its like soy sauce with half the salt. 1 cup Worcester sauce. Thats it. Put your meat and liquid in a glass 9 x 13 dish, cover with wrap and put in fridge over nite. The liquid should just cover the meat. No need to waste with lots of extra liquid. Next batch add 1/2 cup of brown sugar. Next, some wasabe powder. Follow the directions and turn it into a paste. Start with 2 table spoons . Next batch 1cup Braggs, 1 cup Mirin, 3 table spoons wasabe.

Follow the directions on the dehydrator you bought.

Enjoy.
